title: Little Boy in Driveway of Spanish Style Suburban House, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot capturing a young boy standing in front of the driveway of a Spanish Revival-style suburban house, waving toward the camera. A mid-to-late 1950s car is parked inside the arched porte-cochère. The single-story stucco home features tiled roofing, arched walkways, manicured hedges, a television antenna on top, and house number 3984 painted on the curb, reflecting mid-20th century American suburban living.
